local_facts.claim: For an intrastate household move that begins and ends in California, a mover's advertising and moving documents must show its Bureau-issued CAL-T number. California's Maximum Rate Tariff 4 requires a written Agreement for Moving Services with a Not to Exceed Price before service begins, subject to bona fide written change orders.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A San Jose household staying in California should verify the mover's Cal-T authority and read the completed agreement before loading. The Cal-T number is a checkable license identifier, and the written Not to Exceed Price is more protective than a verbal or generic online quote.
local_facts.title: A California move has a Cal-T number and a written price ceiling

local_facts.claim: A household move from San Jose to another state is governed by federal interstate rules rather than California's intrastate tariff. FMCSA says the carrier must provide a written estimate based on an actual or virtual inspection; a binding estimate protects the stated delivery amount, while a non-binding estimate is subject to a 110-percent collection limit at delivery.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A state line changes the paperwork, estimate protections, and carrier verification steps. A San Jose household moving out of California should ask whether its federal estimate is binding or non-binding rather than assuming that a California Not to Exceed agreement applies.
local_facts.title: The protections change when a San Jose move crosses a state line

local_facts.claim: San José lists tow-away permits and Downtown lane-closure permits through its Department of Transportation. The City strongly recommends submitting a tow-away application at least two weeks in advance and says transportation-permit processing can take two business days or more.
local_facts.why_it_matters: For apartment buildings, Downtown addresses, and difficult curbs, truck access must be coordinated before moving day. Building permission alone does not create a legal loading space, so an access plan may require a City permit and an early reservation.
local_facts.title: The curb can need as much planning as the apartment
